sloka: अरुजन् पर्वत अग्राणि हुताशन सखो अनिलः ।बलवान् अप्रमेयः च वायुः आकाश गोचरः ॥४-६७-९॥
transliteration: arujan parvata agrāṇi hutāśana sakho anilaḥ ।balavān aprameyaḥ ca vāyuḥ ākāśa gocaraḥ ॥4-67-9॥

translations.english: 'The Windgod is a friend of fire who is a powerful consumer of oblations. His strength is immeasurable. He wanders in the sky and shatters the mountain tops.
